research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Augment Code is researching AI powered software development tools. Using natural language to perform context aware code generation describes receiving code selections and natural language tasks, then generating modifications using a knowledge base. Fill in the middle code completions using static code analysis focuses on prefix and suffix based completions. Enterprise specific code generation using generative artificial intelligence targets client specific code bases. Together these cover chat like edits, completions, and guided code changes.

product_launches.description: Augment Code has officially launched its Remote Agents feature, allowing developers to run up to ten AI agents in parallel in the cloud to automate coding tasks such as bug fixing, refactoring, and test coverage extension.

press_references.value: Augment Code debuts AI agent with 70% win rate over GitHub Copilot and record-breaking SWE-bench score

product_launches.description: An AI coding assistant designed to handle large software engineering projects with a 70% win rate over GitHub Copilot and a record-breaking SWE-bench score.

overview_description.description: Augment Code builds AI agents that understand entire codebases to generate, review, and manage software. It offers deep contextual code comprehension, IDE and CLI integration, and automated task coordination. Developers can also leverage semantic code analysis, remote agents, and personalized prompt suggestions to streamline complex projects.
